name: methods
value: Baseline characteristics were compared between groups defined by Car origin. Data are presented as mean±SD for continuous measures, and No./total (row %) for categorical measures. P-values were calculated using independent t-test, Pearson's chi-squared test. A two-sided p-value < 0.05 was considered statistically significant. Analysis performed in Stata 17 (StataCorp, College Station, TX).
